issue_request: FHIR-43456 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6 to align Observation with the Event workflow pattern: add workflow mappings from Observation.category to Event.category and Observation.note to Event.note, remove trial-use Observation.instantiates[x] and related search/example surface, use statusReason and relevantHistory extensions, and not add Observation.recorded after the final FHIR-40384-linked decision.
initial_application: Core changes were already applied by Jira-tagged commits. 5003b4ef48 removed Observation.instantiates[x] from source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml and added the Event.category and Event.note workflow mappings. a96b49f958 removed the Observation instantiates-canonical and instantiates-reference search parameters from source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Observation as an active OO resource, so the inspected Observation source is in current build scope. FHIR-40384 is a Published FHIR-extensions supporting decision that added the observation-human-transcribed extension instead of adding Observation.recorded in core. The Extension Pack also lists Observation as context for event-statusReason and event-eventHistory. OO Confluence minutes support this interpretation, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. source/observation/observation.svg still shows instantiates[x], but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact rather than the authoritative XML definition.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml has the requested Event.category and Event.note mappings and no Observation.instantiates[x] or Observation.recorded element. Current source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml has no Observation instantiates search parameters. The extension portions of the decision are represented in the FHIR Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Published FHIR-extensions issue that explains why Observation.recorded was not added to core and instead introduced the observation-human-transcribed extension.
